tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently dined at a restaurant near your campus called The Garden Bistro and had an excellent experience. However, you noticed that the menu could be improved. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Express gratitude for the dining experience you had and explain what you liked about it.
Explain your concerns about the menu.
Suggest ways to improve the menu and the restaurant.
tasks.subject: Dining Experience and Menu Improvement
